findings.reason: the node would implement the drop as prescribed and silently weaken the parity case for the views whose `checked_at` is data; the plan should scope the exemption to the budget composition stamp or state why a name-wide drop is safe.
findings.text: §30's Deliverable makes `checked_at` a member of `_VOLATILE_KEYS`, which `_without_the_composition_instant` applies as a recursive key-name drop over every view's document (`tests/test_crew_view_serves_every_view.py:326-340`), so every field named `checked_at` at any depth in any of the 21 served views stops being compared; the review-view document carries exactly such a field, copied from a *stored* review record and not from the composition instant (`reckon/mcp_views.py:1367` reads `row.get("checked_at")` off `dict(finding)` and re-emits it at 1376-1391, and `compose_review` reaches the served `plan-review`/`findings` views at `reckon/mcp_views.py:1466`), which contradicts the contract the same constant states — "every other field, including every stamp read out of a file, must still agree, which is what makes the comparison worth making" (`tests/test_crew_view_serves_every_view.py:311-320) — while the section asserts only that no *clock-derived* figure is dropped

findings.reason: without a named mechanism the gate is the vacuous one the rubric warns about (it passes on the unfixed tree), and the fix is either to name the clock-advance hook in the Deliverable or to drop the requirement from the done-when.
findings.text: §30's done-when requires the parity case to pass "10 of 10 runs … with the clock advanced 30 seconds between the two calls of each pair" and its negative control to fail "while keeping that clock advance", but nothing in the section produces that advance: the section's own evidence needed an out-of-tree pytest plugin that replaced `budget._now` (`evidence/probe.py` under `r-20261021T053953745347-…`, run with `-p probe`, whose control arm fails and whose drop arm passes `EXIT=0`), the Deliverable is confined to the one-line set change, and the write path is the test file alone — so a worker handed this brief runs the case as it stands, where the two calls are milliseconds apart and `checked_at` is second-resolution (`reckon/budget.py:1529`), and reports 10 of 10 having exercised nothing
